ingredients.name: butter, melted, plus extra for the pan

steps.title: Mix the dry ingredients
steps.text: Whisk {0001} flour, {0002} baking powder, {0003} salt and {0004} sugar in a large bowl.

steps.title: Add the wet ingredients
steps.text: Stir in {0005} milk, {0006} large egg and {0007} melted butter until just combined. A few lumps are fine.

steps.title: Rest the batter
steps.text: Let the batter sit while the pan heats over medium heat.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Pour about 1/4 cup of batter per pancake into a buttered pan. Flip when bubbles form and the edges look set, then cook until golden.

notes: Stir as little as possible for tender pancakes. This is a stand-in recipe so the site has something to show.
